releases.notes:
## Sequoia 1.11.2

- Keep available updates visible and make interrupted installations recoverable.
- Reduce the mod download size by compressing the bundled image preview helpers.
- Verify bundled image preview helpers before running them.
- Add dedicated player guides for commands, settings, maps, wars, and other features.

- Preview supported chat images and GIFs using the optional sandboxed media preview feature.
- Share the in-game guild HQ and fastest/cheapest trade style between connected Sequoia clients.
- Show a fading “CHEAPEST SUCCESS” message after queuing a war while your own HQ is known to use cheapest. The effect respects Easter eggs and Screen Effects settings.
- Keep the HQ crown clear of territory and queue labels on the war map.
- Replace manual HQ assignment with observed in-game data.

This release corrects the publishing setup from the assetless GitHub 1.11.0 entry. The installed mod version and published version now agree.

HQ/style sharing needs actual menu or style-change observations from an updated client. Unknown or expired information does not trigger the effect.

## Important update

Please update Sequoia and restart Minecraft to keep connecting to the updated backend.

Existing linked accounts are preserved.
